description: Defines the ObliviousHttpClient class for client-side Oblivious HTTP request handling, including creation and decryption of requests/responses, with dependencies on OpenSSL and Abseil libraries.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpClient
classes.description: Client class for managing Oblivious HTTP requests and responses, including creation and decryption, using HPKE public key.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ObliviousHttpClient with server's HPKE public key and configuration.

methods.name: CreateObliviousHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates an Oblivious HTTP request with the given plaintext data.

methods.name: DecryptObliviousHttpResponse
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted Oblivious HTTP response using the request context.
